original: 映画、楽しんできてね。

en.text: Have a good time at the movies.

original: 私は楽しんでいます。

en.text: I'm having a blast.
I'm having fun.
I'm enjoying myself.

original: 一人の時間を楽しんでいた。

en.text: I was enjoying some alone time.

original: 気球にのって空を楽しむ。

en.text: I'll enjoy the sky in a balloon.
You'll be able to enjoy the sky on that hot-air balloon.
It's a good time being in the sky on a hot-air balloon.

original: 彼女は授業を本当に楽しんだ。

en.text: She really enjoyed the class.
